summary: Frontend-only test of v1.7.1: clicking a cast member or director in the Library detail window opens the Stats FilmographyDialog. Run in the simulated electronAPI harness. New suite /app/tests/test_iter43_detail_filmography.py: 44 of 45 checks pass. The one failure is a minor edge case (a card that has directors[] but no director string). Regression run_filmography, run_person_filter and run_missing all pass, with no page errors.

ui_bugs.issue: The movie-director span is shown only when selectedMovie.director (the string) is set. A card with only directors[] and no director string has no clickable director. Real TMDB fetches set both fields, so normal users are unlikely to hit this.

verified: cast-member-{i} is a <button type=button>. The pop-up shows the same name, count and list as Stats: Actor X 'Appears in 8 films', newest first, excluding Himself/Concert/TV/Doc credits. The header photo, the show-library button and the missing section are all present.
Closing the pop-up with Escape or the X returns to the detail window, which stays open. Pressing Escape again with no pop-up open closes the detail window.
A Himself-only actor (Cameo Guy) gets a pop-up showing 0 films and no Show all button.
movie-director-link-0 for Dir A shows 'Directed 8 films' with no 'as' text. The 'Dir B, Dir C' director string gives 2 links, each 'Directed 1 film'.
Clicking filmography-item opens the target film's detail window: the pop-up closes, there is a single detail window, and open= is removed from the URL. Clicking the same film reopens it.

Show all in Library (from a director or a cast member) closes both windows. The chip shows 'Dir B · 1 film' / 'Actor X · 8 films' and the grid is filtered to match. person-filter-clear restores the full grid.
Missing films via the detail pop-up (PersonMock): the actor shows Miss10..Miss3 and the director shows Directed2, Directed1.
clear-cast-btn still works and the detail window stays open.
action_items: Optional: change the gate at LocalLibraryPage.jsx ~2628 from selectedMovie.director to filmDirectors(selectedMovie).length > 0 (and include directors in the movie-extra-details condition), so cards with only directors[] still show clickable directors.
critical_code_review_comments: Clicking a film in the pop-up navigates to '/?open=id', which drops any active person/qf filter from the URL. Example seen: the Actor X filter was active, I opened a film from the Actor Y pop-up, and the chip disappeared. This is acceptable because the opened film is always visible, but it is worth noting.
Director button key={d.name}. If a film's director list contains the same name twice, React would warn about duplicate keys. Minor.
The Escape capture handler correctly skips closing the detail window while a Radix dialog is open.
LocalLibraryPage.jsx is about 3300 lines (left alone, as you asked).
seed_data_creation: None. The libraries are injected per browser context with the harness init_script (TEST_ prefixed cards).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: g={'page':page}; exec(open('/app/tests/test_iter43_detail_filmography.py').read(), g); await g['run_detail_people'](); await g['run_detail_missing'](). The regression functions are reachable as g['g42']['run_person_filter'], g['g42']['run_missing'] and g['g42']['g41']['run_filmography']. lib43() adds director strings to film_lib cards, plus TEST_OnlyArr (directors[] only).
